headline: Highest risk is medium: shared workspace and Notion outputs can feed Prefect workflows, creating prompt-injection, leakage, and compliance exposure; no critical default harm is evidenced.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Notion AI can read and summarize shared workspace pages, and Prefect can consume workflow metadata or downstream inputs. Because the pair shares workspace state and Notion treats file/page content as grounded input, malicious content in Notion pages could influence Prefect-driven automation. The interaction is documented only at profile level, so uncertainty pushes to medium.
conditions: IF Prefect ingests Notion-generated text or page content as workflow input
IF a shared workspace page contains attacker-controlled instructions
mitigations: Restrict Prefect inputs to allowlisted fields only
Add a manual review step before any automation consumes Notion output
Tag Notion-sourced content as untrusted in workflow metadata
Separate collaboration pages from automation source pages
requires-engineering: implement provenance tracking between Notion and Prefect

B_data_leakage.rationale: Notion touches workspace pages and team knowledge base content, while Prefect has broad network egress and can move workflow metadata externally. If Prefect is configured to ingest Notion pages or exports, sensitive workspace content can leave the workspace. The profiles do not show a hard block, so the plausible shared-data path warrants medium severity.
conditions: IF Prefect receives Notion page content or exports
IF the shared workspace contains sensitive team knowledge base material
mitigations: Limit Prefect to metadata-only inputs
Disable any workflow step that uploads page bodies
Use a redaction pass before handoff
Review outbound destinations for Prefect jobs
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention rules on the handoff

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Notion AI has no filesystem write, shell, or subprocess capability, while Prefect is an orchestration tool with broad network egress but no explicit shared write surface is shown. The profiles do not evidence overlapping mutable-resource writes, so direct capability conflict is limited. Shared workspace state exists, but the write-conflict pathway is not established.
conditions: IF Prefect is configured to write back into the same workspace pages Notion edits
IF an external orchestrator grants both agents write access to one mutable resource
mitigations: Assign separate write targets per agent
Freeze shared pages during automation runs
Use read-only exports for Prefect inputs
Check for overlapping OAuth or API scopes
requires-engineering: add locking around shared mutable resources

D_cascading_error.rationale: Notion AI is a RAG-style Q&A system grounded in workspace content, and Prefect can orchestrate downstream actions. If Prefect treats Notion output as authoritative, errors or hallucinations can cascade into automated workflow steps. Because the profiles do not show verification gates by default, the interaction is plausibly dangerous but not clearly irreversible.
conditions: IF Prefect uses Notion-generated summaries as decision inputs
IF no human or rule-based verification occurs before execution
mitigations: Require schema validation on Notion outputs
Insert a human approval step before execution
Compare Notion output against source pages
Log provenance for every downstream action
requires-engineering: add automated consistency checks

E_compliance.rationale: Notion handles workspace pages and team knowledge base content, while Prefect can transmit workflow metadata over broad egress. If regulated or residency-bound content is placed in Notion and then moved through Prefect, retention or residency obligations can diverge. The profiles do not show matching compliance controls, so the safest reading is medium.
conditions: IF regulated content is stored in Notion pages
IF Prefect exports that content or derived metadata across jurisdictions
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of the shared workflow
Minimize fields passed from Notion to Prefect
Document retention for both systems
Review residency of all Prefect destinations
requires-engineering: align compliance controls across both vendors
